summary: Extends the accepted E20 INT8 group-128 W8A16 mechanism from the KDA input projection to four further attention projection families that run as BF16 GEMMs on the accepted E03 recipe.

e20_kda_w8a16.py.change: Accepted source plus one flag-gated call at the end of finalize_kda_input_w8a16. With the flag unset or 0 it performs exactly the accepted conversion.

e21_bf16_residue.py.change: New module. Reuses the accepted _dequant_nk_kernel from e20_hybrid_scratch.py.

kv-transfer-config.json.change: Only spark_cache_root differs, so the candidate never reads or writes the accepted E03 cache.

families.name: mla_o_proj
families.on_disk: fp8_block_128 dequantized to bf16 on load

families.name: mla_fused_qkv_a_proj
families.on_disk: fp8_block_128 dequantized to bf16 on load

families.name: mla_q_b_proj
families.on_disk: fp8_block_128 dequantized to bf16 on load

excluded.kda_f_g_gates: They drive a recurrent decay state, so a small relative error accumulates along the sequence.
excluded.mla_kv_b_proj: Absorbed by the MLA attention backend and on the FP8 KV and SparkCache path.
excluded.mla_indexer_projections: They select which tokens sparse attention reads.
excluded.dflash2_drafter: Its acceptance rate already limits prose throughput.
excluded.mla_no_q_lora_families: Declared for completeness; they cannot fire because the checkpoint uses q_lora_rank 1536.

memory_per_rank.note: Freed memory raises MemAvailable; the KV pool stays fixed at 16106127360 bytes.

expected_effect.basis: Validated weight-traffic cost model and the E20 conversion ratio 0.45-0.54, recorded in the private attribution receipt. The ratio comes from two accepted E20 runs with decision_required and a concurrent KV change, so it is an estimate, not a measurement.

rollback: Down with this overlay, then deploy/up with the overlay the owner selected before the window. The accepted E20 hook and scratch files are never modified.
limits: The offline tests exercise configuration, selection, validation and dispatch with stubbed dependencies. They do not execute Marlin, Triton or CUDA.
GPU kernel correctness, CUDA graph capture and torch.compile behaviour are unproven until the first authorized boot and its functional gates.

The forward of the installed DeepSeekV2FusedQkvAProjLinear is not in the checkout. Upstream vLLM has a low-latency path that reads self.weight directly; it must be confirmed absent or inactive in the R10 image before the window.
For the three MLA families the INT8 step is a second quantization of weights already dequantized from FP8, so numeric error must be measured against the FP8-dequantized reference.
No throughput, latency or prefill effect is established by this preparation.
